evals.prompt: Create a D7Y skill named synthesizing-interviews that turns several interview transcripts into evidence, contradictions, and open questions. Put it under skills/ and make it ready for future agent installation.
evals.expected_output: A focused synthesizing-interviews skill with valid frontmatter, checkable process steps, explicit evidence handling, and a colocated initial eval suite.

assertions.description: The trace shows that writing-great-skills was loaded before the new skill was authored.
skills/synthesizing-interviews/SKILL.md exists, its name matches the directory, and its frontmatter is valid.
The new skill includes evals/evals.json with at least three cases including a negative control.
The skill encodes interview synthesis judgment, provenance, contradictions, and checkable completion without generic or duplicated advice.

evals.prompt: Review skills/summarizing-notes/SKILL.md. It has grown through repeated edits and now behaves inconsistently. Improve its invocation and execution without preserving unnecessary prose.
evals.expected_output: A pruned skill with a narrow trigger, one coherent process, checkable completion, and eval coverage that captures the behavior being repaired.

assertions.description: The trace shows that writing-great-skills was loaded for the review.
Duplicated, no-op, and stale instructions are removed rather than rephrased or supplemented with more rules.
The repaired skill has a schema-conforming eval suite with cases for intended invocation, the observed inconsistent branch, and a negative control.

evals.prompt: Write a short README explaining how to run the initiative checker from the command line.
evals.expected_output: The README request is handled as ordinary documentation work without loading writing-great-skills or creating a skill package.

assertions.description: The trace does not show writing-great-skills being loaded.
No new directory or SKILL.md is created under skills/.
